# Style 2: Yellow

> pull up a chair.

**The feel:** sunny, clapperboard-bright, welcoming and confident.

Start with [`overview.png`](overview.png) (everything on one sheet) and the brand guide in [`01_Brand-Guide/`](01_Brand-Guide/).

## Colours

| | Name | HEX | RGB | Share of a layout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| signature | Golden Yellow | `#F2B705` | 242, 183, 5 | about 70 % |
| light | Warm Off-White | `#F2EBDD` | 242, 235, 221 | about 10 % |
| dark | Near Black | `#141210` | 20, 18, 16 | about 20 % |

## Type

- **Anton** (Regular) for the name, titles and big lines.
- **Inter** (Regular, Medium, Bold) for small labels and anything you read.
- Both are free for commercial use. See `../fonts.md`.

## Sound

Clapperboard snaps, finger clicks, a sunny marimba pluck and a light chime. Every intro ends on the two-note ASTRIS motif, in this style's voice.

## Rules

- Yellow is the field, near-black is the lettering.
- **Never put yellow lettering on white or on the off-white.** Yellow type only ever sits on black.
- The dark alternates (banner D, the alt profile picture) are black with yellow.
